headlines.title: Rep. Andy Ogles loses his Republican primary in Tennessee
headlines.description: Rep. Andy Ogles of Tennessee has lost his Republican primary, NBC News projects, falling to a former state official in a primary season that has seen an unusually high number of incumbents lose renomination.

headlines.title: Sen. Marsha Blackburn wins the Republican primary for governor of Tennessee
headlines.description: Blackburn, a longtime Trump ally, defeated Rep. John Rose for the nomination, NBC News projects, after the president decided not to endorse in the race.

headlines.title: Spokane Wildfire Suspect Confesses to Setting Dozens of Fires
headlines.description: Aaron Farinacci, the man charged with setting one of the most destructive fires in the history of Washington state, appeared in court on Thursday for his arraignment. According to court documents, detectives say Farinacci confessed to using a weather app to wait for a dry and windy day before starting the fire. Farinacci also claims he ignited 25 other fires near his home between July and August of 2025. NBC’s Morgan Chesky reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Maine surgical nurse released from immigration detention following outcry
headlines.description: A registered nurse is back with her family after a weeklong fight with the support of community members and colleagues from Maine Medical Center, who demanded she be released from immigration detention.

headlines.title: Idaho police release chilling new video of In-N-Out mass shooting
headlines.description: Police released new surveillance footage of the mass shooting at an In-N-Out in Twin Falls, Idaho, showing the clearest account yet of the horrific scene.

headlines.title: Woman sues Yankees for $10M after getting struck by bat, says she suffered brain injury
headlines.description: A New Jersey woman is suing the New York Yankees for $10 million after a bat flew into the stands and struck her in the head, which she says gave her a brain injury.

headlines.title: How 3 health factors can help delay dementia for up to 13 years
headlines.description: New research from NYU Langone Health found that people who avoid three vascular risk factors in middle age had about 13 more dementia-free years.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll appeal decision halting ballroom construction to the Supreme Court
headlines.description: A federal appeals court affirmed a federal judge’s ruling to block construction of the White House ballroom while allowing below-ground construction to move forward.
